_comment: SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT. Verus telemetry (Component 2). TEAM DEFAULT: one Verus MCP server per session, launched over stdio by .claude/bin/verus-mcp. The launcher exports VERUS_MCP_WORKSPACE=<this clone> (so the server verifies and indexes THIS checkout, which matters for worktrees), locates a Verus toolchain and puts verus/cargo-verus in the server's environment, and installs a pinned verus-tools-mcp if none is present. Run `.claude/bin/verus-mcp --check` to see what it resolves. The SessionStart gate (.claude/hooks/verus_gate.py) probes this same launcher and blocks if the server is unreachable or its toolchain cannot run Verus. Hacking on the server itself? Use the hot-reload HTTP config instead: `ln -sf .mcp.dev.json .mcp.json`. See .claude/hooks/README.md.
